text: Acceptance step 2 installs a GLOBAL tool_result hook that calls Jev synchronously on every tool result in every repo with the SDK's default retry policy and WITHHOLDS the result when Jev is unreachable. That is a fail-closed hook blocking on a remote call: a Jev outage, a 429 storm or an expired key blinds every agent in every repo, and each retry adds latency to every tool result. Step 3 then runs it 'in all repos for 7 days' with no call cap, no spend cap, no latency budget, no host-pane-1 off switch, no committed bar, and 'report withheld counts' as the only output, so nothing can fail it. It closes on 'commit:<sha>' with no non-author verifier named, has no dependency edges, sits outside the mission root's prerequisites, and duplicates jev-j0er, which already owns the machine-wide screen with fail-open, a latency budget and an off switch. Overlap: r1/L2-ResearchAgent.jsonl jev-grzn.2 (class research-misapplied) already named the sync/retry/fail-closed breach; the missing call and spend caps, the missing off switch, the bar-less 7-day run and the self-close are not in any r1 row.
